VP-Head of High-Value Mobility Growth

The Head of High-Value Mobility Growth is responsible for growing and retaining high-value customer segments, including postpaid, SME and roaming users. This role focuses on driving customer loyalty, increasing revenue through upsell and cross-sell strategies, and enhancing customer experience to maximize lifetime value.

By leveraging data-driven insights, customer segmentation, and targeted engagement programs, the Head of High-Value Mobility Growth ensures that high-value customers receive personalized offerings and superior service. Working closely with sales, product, and customer experience teams, this role plays a key part in reducing churn, improving retention, and driving sustainable revenue growth in Indonesia’s competitive telecom market.

Responsibilities

• Develop and implement strategies to grow the postpaid and SME customer base.
• Develop and implement strategies to grow the roaming customer base.
• Design and execute loyalty programs to enhance customer retention.
• Drive revenue growth by optimizing cross-sell and upsell initiatives.
• Use customer analytics to personalize offerings and improve engagement.
• Monitor revenue performance and align marketing efforts with business targets.
• Ensure seamless and enhanced customer journeys to drive satisfaction.
• Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Customer Experience teams for seamless execution.
• Build and mentor a high-performing marketing team with a focus on innovation and agility.

Qualifications

• Experience in postpaid, SME & Roaming customer segment growth.
• Strong background in loyalty and customer retention marketing.
• Ability to leverage data for customer segmentation and personalization.
• Proven track record in cross-sell and upsell optimization.
• Expertise in driving high-value customer engagement strategies.
• Strong leadership and analytical skills.

About Us

INDICO is Telkomsel Group’s digital company, focused on developing and scaling digital platforms beyond core connectivity.

As part of Telkomsel Group, INDICO enables collaboration to support end-to-end digital use cases, ranging from customer engagement and transactions to loyalty, commerce, and data intelligence.

Through its platforms, INDICO transforms group capabilities into scalable and repeatable solutions that support Telkomsel’s digital growth and unlock new business opportunities across the ecosystem.

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product teams across the Education and Health sectors.

What you will do but not limited to:

• Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
• Lead product development from problem discovery to delivery and continuous improvement.
• Work closely with Business/Commercial teams to deliver product and business targets.
• Define, implement, monitor, and analyze product and business metrics relevant to different products and business lines.
• Use data, analytics, and customer insights to identify opportunities, evaluate outcomes, and improve products.
• Own project delivery metrics, including on-time delivery and execution quality.
• Work closely with Product Designers and Engineering teams to deliver products.
• Lead product integration with the Telkomsel ecosystem and systems.
• Ensure product initiatives deliver clear ROI.

Requirements

• 4-7 years of Product Management experience, including experience leading products or product teams at a Lead/Senior PM level in a unicorn or similarly scaled technology company.
• Proven track record of building, improving, and scaling products across B2C, B2B, or B2G environments.
• Strong data and analytics capabilities, with the ability to define, implement, monitor, and analyze metrics across different product and business lines.
• Proven success delivering measurable product and business outcomes in a similar context.
• Strong product judgment and ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.
• Experience working closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Business/Commercial teams.
• Strong understanding of experimentation, product performance, and ROI.
• Experience integrating products with large enterprise ecosystems or Telco systems is a strong advantage.
• Experience with Telkomsel systems such as NBP or BID is a major advantage.
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
